newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PAPER EXPORT PRICES FELL IN NOVEMBER - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PAPER EXPORT PRICES FELL IN NOVEMBER - SF.

text.p: Finnish pulp, paper and paper product export prices fell again in November after showing a flat +/-0 percent month-on-month change in October, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
Pulp, paper and paper product export prices fell 1.2 percent in November on October, which took the export price index down 0.2 percent month-on-month, SF said.
Year-on-year, pulp, paper and paper products prices fell 12.9 percent, while the export price index fell 4.0 percent year-on-year, it said.

The month-on-month change in pulp, paper and paper product export prices had been in the red every month since March except for the flat October reading. The export price index had also fallen every month since March except for a 0.3 percent month-on-month rise in October.
In November, export prices of base metals fell 0.4 percent month-on-month for a 16.9 percent fall year-on-year, SF said.
Export prices of machinery and equipment were unchanged in November compared to October and they rose 3.9 percent year-on-year, it said.
Export prices of electrotechnical products and optical equipment rose 1.8 percent month-on-month and they rose 1.4 percent year-on-year.
